text:
Amina (People Ops): Heads-up: Carlos M (Mexico) has a mismatch on SSN vs payroll record; vendor paused the background. Also he doesn't have a local government ID with a photo on file (passport expired). We have day-1 tentatively Mon 11/4 09:00 PT. Need plan for I-9 equivalent + laptop shipping.

Carlos M (candidate): Hi all 91 - I renewed my passport but new one arrives in 10 days. I do have consular ID (INE) and a utility bill. I can meet a courier in Mexico City to show originals if that helps.

Diego - Background Ops: Vendor notes: for Mexico-based remote hires we need either a passport OR two gov IDs; SSN mismatch needs a paystub or SSA letter (for US SSN). If Carlos has a Mexican RFC on file that's fine but payroll currently has US SSN data.

Amina (People Ops): Carlos, can you confirm if payroll was given a US SSN by mistake? Also, can you upload the consular ID + utility bill now?

Carlos M (candidate): Payroll entry used my US SSN from a previous contract years ago. I can provide a recent Mexican tax ID (RFC) and upload a scanned consular ID + utility bill today.

Priya (Benefits): Benefits note: contractors in MX get a prorated meal stipend only. Enrollment link goes out within 14 days of start. If start changes >7 days, manager approval needed to extend.

Maya - IT: For hardware, we can schedule an in-person document pickup (courier) where Carlos shows originals to the courier and they sign off. That counts for our local I-9 equiv intake. We need candidate confirmation and a secure pickup address.

CourierBot: Available local partner: MX-CITY-Couriers. Earliest pickup slot: 2024-11-02 14:00 CST. Fee applies. Reply `!book pickup 2024-11-02 14:00` to reserve.

Amina (People Ops): Proposed steps:

```
1) Carlos uploads consular_ID.pdf + utility_bill.pdf today
2) Payroll update: switch record to MX RFC and remove old US SSN entry (run by payroll)
3) Book courier for in-person doc verification 2024-11-02 14:00 CST
4) Vendor re-run background after courier sign-off
5) Tentative start: 2024-11-04 09:00 PT (confirm after clearance)
```

Diego - Background Ops: Important: vendor needs a photo of candidate with the consular ID (selfie holding ID) taken during courier visit OR a notarized selfie taken locally. Courier sign-off + timestamped photo is preferred.

Carlos M (candidate): I agree to courier pickup. My address: Calle Reforma 123, Col. Centro, CDMX. Phone +52-55-1234-5678. I'll be home 11/02 afternoon.

Maya - IT: Noted. Carlos - please DM the exact shipping address so we don't post PII in channel. I'll create ticket and put laptop on hold.

Ruth (Hiring Manager): I can approve stipend window extension if we need it. We prefer him ready for the 11/4 sprint though.

Priya (Benefits): Please note: if start slips into the next payroll cycle we may need to adjust stipend proration. I'll watch payroll adjustments.

Amina (People Ops): Carlos - once courier confirms pickup and Diego confirms vendor acceptance, we'll lock the start. CourierBot - please reserve 11/02 14:00 CST if possible.

CourierBot: Command received. To confirm booking run: `!book confirm MX-CITY-Couriers 11/02-14:00` within 2 hours. Fee estimate MXN 250.

Maya - IT: Created ticket IT-4321. Laptop kit held. Ship once courier confirmation & address DM received.

Carlos M (candidate): DM sent with address and phone. Confirming availability 11/02 14:00 CST. I will have consular ID originals and utility bill with me.

Diego - Background Ops: once courier completes verification please have them upload timestamped photo and signed PDF to the secure intake portal. Vendor will re-run within 24h of receipt.

Amina (People Ops): TL;DR checklist:

```
- Candidate uploads consular_ID.pdf + utility_bill.pdf (done)
- Candidate DM'd shipping address (done)
- Book courier pickup 2024-11-02 14:00 CST (pending confirm)
- Courier to collect original docs + timestamped selfie and upload signed receipt
- Payroll to update record to MX RFC and remove old US SSN entry
- Vendor re-run clearance; if green -> start 2024-11-04 09:00 PT
```

Ruth (Hiring Manager): Approve stipend extension if needed. Let's aim for 11/4.

CourierBot: Booking confirmation needed. Run: `!book confirm MX-CITY-Couriers 11/02-14:00`.

Amina (People Ops): I'll run the booking now and DM Carlos the courier ETA link. Thanks everyone.

Carlos M (candidate): Thank you team 91 - uploaded docs and ready for courier. Looking forward to joining!
